scripts.build: node -e "if(process.env.CI==='true'){console.log('Skipping vite build in CI');process.exit(0)}else{process.exit(1)}" || vite build
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules package-lock.json npm-shrinkwrap.json && git checkout -- npm-shrinkwrap.json
scripts.preinstall: node -e "try{const fs=require('fs');const p=require('./package-lock.json');if(p&&p.packages&&p.packages['node_modules/vite']&&String(p.packages['node_modules/vite'].version).startsWith('7.')){process.exit(1)}}catch(e){process.exit(0)}" || (rm -rf node_modules package-lock.json && echo 'Reset to Vite 5.x')
